message.content: {"research_brief": "How did the HyperFund/HyperVerse alleged crypto-fraud network operate and recruit investors, specifically: (1) what alleged crypto-Ponzi or pyramid-style mechanics, payment promises, referral incentives, withdrawal restrictions, or other financial structures were used; (2) which public promoters, influencers, representatives, or affiliated entities publicly marketed or endorsed it, what they said or did, and how their promotion may have supported recruitment; (3) how and why the operation reportedly rebranded from HyperFund to HyperVerse or used related names, websites, platforms, or corporate identities; (4) what evidence exists regarding the identity, biography, credentials, public appearances, and alleged or questionable persona of its purported CEO or senior leader; (5) how these elements interacted to establish credibility, attract participants, solicit funds, and sustain the network; and (6) what chronology, entities, relationships, allegations, assessments, uncertainties, and contradictions can be established solely from evidence returned by the benchmark tools as of October 1, 2026? I want a complete final report, without being asked whether to continue, using only tool-returned evidence and citing only source IDs returned by those tools; do not invent facts, clearly label allegations, assessments, and uncertainty, and omit or qualify unsupported claims. Present the report in readable Markdown and include a fenced JSON object with exactly the arrays `findings`, `claims`, `reasoning_steps`, and `contradictions`, where each finding contains `question`, `answer`, `supporting_entities`, and `source_references`; each claim contains `claim` and `source_references`; each reasoning step contains `id`, `conclusion`, `premise_entities`, and `premise_relations`; and each contradiction contains `contradiction_id`, `description`, and `source_references`. Use entity IDs and relationship names only when directly supported by the benchmark-tool evidence; no additional source, geographic, language, date-range, or source-type restrictions are specified beyond prioritizing the most direct and authoritative evidence available through the tools."}
